action.objective: Commit Nf6+ winning the rook on d7 and continuing the forced mating attack.
action.rationale: Both d1a1 and e4f6 verified exact 99997 at shared depth 3. e4f6 is a forcing check that attacks d7 rook; PV e4f6 g8h8 d7h7 wins the rook with decisive material. d1a1's PV also leaves Black capturing a bishop on b4. Prefer the check which keeps the initiative and wins material immediately with no opposing captures available after Nf6+.
